parts.title: Getting Started
parts.description: What Android is, how apps run on a phone, installing Android Studio, and running your very first app.

parts.title: Kotlin Essentials
parts.description: The language of modern Android. Learn it properly first: types, control flow, collections, null safety, classes, lambdas and coroutines.

parts.title: UI with Jetpack Compose
parts.description: Build screens declaratively: composables, layouts, Material 3 components, state, lists, theming, side effects and animation.

parts.title: App Architecture
parts.description: How real apps are structured: the Activity lifecycle, navigation between screens, ViewModels, layered architecture and dependency injection with Hilt.

parts.title: Data & Networking
parts.description: Fetch data from web APIs with Retrofit, store it locally with Room and DataStore, and make your app work offline.

parts.title: The Android Platform
parts.description: Intents, runtime permissions, background work, notifications, images and media, plus the legacy View system you'll meet in older code.

parts.title: Quality & Shipping
parts.description: Test your code, debug and profile like a pro, then sign, build and publish your app on Google Play.

parts.title: Capstone: RecipeBox
parts.description: Put everything together and build a complete, production-style app from an empty project to a release build.
